verdict.rationale: Several Dashboard actions have documented API equivalents: an API-based Terminal integration, fleet locations and zones via API, reader registration by serial number, refunds via the Refunds API or Dashboard, and receipt data from the API. An OpenAPI spec, the Stripe CLI and an official MCP server add programmatic and agent access, and an HN user praises the ability to 'fully integrate with the API on a terminal level'. However, nothing explicitly claims full UI/API parity, and some Dashboard flows have no API equivalent in evidence, such as ordering readers and guided dispute responses. missing for 10: an explicit statement of Dashboard/API parity, API evidence for reader ordering and dispute handling, independent hands-on corroboration of parity.
